# Magic: The Gathering Gotchas

> Known Magic card-data, legality, rules-engine, deckbuilding, and proxy-rendering patterns that cause silent failures or hard-to-debug errors.

## Entries

- [Future-set cards are not format-illegal](future-set-cards-are-not-format-illegal.md): Current Scryfall legality and missing third-party coverage must not silently exclude a qualifying future paper preview from Commander deckbuilding. HIGH.
- [Complete source art can still fail card-frame visibility](complete-source-art-can-still-fail-card-frame-visibility.md): A byte-correct source and successful render can still hide required subject landmarks beneath card-frame overlays. HIGH.
